series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and strong seasonality, but high spectral entropy indicates unpredictable noise. Rankings are unstable, and RMSE spread is significant. Baseline methods with robust median aggregation are recommended to handle the high noise and unreliable model rankings.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true → robust_median is recommended for high noise and unpredictable series
reasoning.trimmed_mean_r0.10: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=-0.1462) → trimmed_mean is robust to unstable rankings and outliers
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon selection captures different model strengths at different horizons

excluded_highlights.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true AND n_windows=2 → inverse weighting may overfit with few windows and high noise
